grading: Human/independent reviewer checks actual artifacts and observable tool results; no keyword-only success. Missing evidence fails. Synthetic task success is not production or backend integration success.

research-assistant: v2 invalidates dependent figure/write outputs; background retained
acyclic plan with bounded CPU budget; completed tasks do not depend on blocked/skipped execution tasks
no invented run, role or completed artifact
research-explore: separates local kernel 2x from end-to-end results
rival explanation and discriminating experiment with fixed metric
bounded go/pivot/stop criteria, no novelty assertion
research-implement-optimize: independent tests actually run; input unchanged
large workload regression and no GPU claim
research-figures: mixed route and unique final owner; no false independent agents
both scopes and exact architecture preserved in labeled panels
editable panel/assembly sources and final combined image actually viewed
research-review: rejects abstract end-to-end universal claim using numbers
does not falsely claim appendix omitted large regression
actionable located findings and no unsupported score
research-read-pdf: all 3 pages actually opened and read
overgeneralization on physical page 2 located, no invented layout defect
paper-reading-companion: 5 to 7.5 calculation correct and universal RoPE claim bounded
physical page 2 retained; notes match PDF hash
real offline HTML generated with no fake live backend
explain-research-concepts: no claim of RoPE-specific universal evidence
travel-planner: both schedules honor lunch window, full duration and 16:00 booking
75-minute independent hotel rest and all commutes in both revisions
per-person meal, per-group photo, per-vehicle fare counted correctly; no real booking claim
research-data-visualization: all 4 rows and scopes preserved, including large regression
no invented error bars or statistical reliability
editable source and final render actually viewed
research-diagrams: exact 6 nodes and 5 directed data-flow edges; V bypasses softmax
proposed/schematic rather than implemented or measured
editable SVG, actual render and visual QA
code-reading: Identifies misleading module narrative using function/line evidence; treats comments as claims
Default picks dimensions [0,2]; optional fixed basis is not query-trained; final score uses full original vectors
Near is a candidate range, forced suffix is separate; skip_far keeps scoring near and final full_score
Caller and data edges with conditions; no target execution or performance claim; preserves read-only input
code-organization: CODEMAP 每行含可核对锚点（脚本路径/结果文件/commit 至少其一），不虚构映射
目录 README 不超过十行且只覆盖必要目录
孤儿与重复文件给提案与回滚方式，不执行删除；运行中管线输出路径未移动
增量更新不重排历史行，diff 可读
